steps.text: 这是体力。走路、受伤都会用掉它；用光了，这一趟就结束了。

texts.en: This is Vitality. Walking and getting hurt both use it up; when it's gone, the run is over.

steps.text: 这是货币。商店买东西、付费撤离点放行，都要它。

texts.en: These are your coins. Shops want them, and so do paid extraction points.

steps.text: 背包：整理棋盘上的东西，打架之前先排好。快捷键 B。

texts.en: Pack: arrange what's on your Board. Sort it before a fight. Hotkey B.

steps.text: 放大镜：再看一眼脚下这个点里还有什么。快捷键 N。

texts.en: Magnifier: take another look at what's left in the spot you're standing on. Hotkey N.
